oracle_origin: Literal original product/AT and frozen contract; baseline code read only to identify original compatibility boundaries, not to generate expected values.
code_under_review: No implementation sign-off; root worktree implementation intentionally not read or executed by this design freeze.

oracles.title: Explicit ordinary admission only
oracles.stimulus: Use the existing ordinary configured_app and exact same-Store CURRENT_PREPARATION service with already legitimate preparation, actors and grants.
oracles.expect: Original local-case read/command/recovery and P5 source use this explicit lane. No new principal, grant, Run assignment, policy, publication or approval is created.
oracles.negative: No ordinary DI, foreign Store/provider, legacy ISOLATED marker, active or inactive Run assignment, Native history and a mixed provider remain denied; an old denial never selects ordinary authority.

oracles.title: Original owner lifecycle sequence and explicit P5 VERIFY
oracles.stimulus: From actually current original P1-P4 business evidence and owner VERIFY events, explicitly REVALIDATE, CLOSE_LOCAL_RECORD, then VERIFY P5.
oracles.expect: Ledger uses original revision/cycle/event/request-key semantics. Close yields LOCAL_RECORD_CLOSED and Case WAITING_CONFIRMATION. P5 is a current verified local output only after the original owner VERIFY matches its current source.
oracles.negative: CLOSE, ledger flags, receipt prose or a mere verified_sha field cannot auto-VERIFY P5 or declare physical fulfillment. Original READY compatibility is preserved, not silently tightened to CLOSED-only.

oracles.title: Original evidence and plan gates stay effective
oracles.stimulus: Omit or stale one material REVIEW/CONFIRM, actual current resource link, ACCEPT/CREATE proof, submitted-and-owner-ACK receipt, original P1-P4 VERIFY, or leave an unresolved material objection.
oracles.expect: REVALIDATE/CLOSE and current P5 output fail or remain blocked under the existing gate; no step, goal, reservation, history or required goal is removed to make the request succeed.
oracles.negative: A synthetic setup or current DTO is not itself business evidence; ordinary admission grants no bypass of original owner verification.

oracles.title: Original absolute offer deadline and generation binding
oracles.stimulus: Change a bound actor grant generation, revoke and restore it, revise bound materials/catalogue, cross the original first-offer absolute deadline, or restart API/worker.
oracles.expect: No fresh P5 validation/close/VERIFY or current P5 source may rely on the expired or changed ordinary acceptance. First offer UUID and at-most-300-second deadline are preserved across restarts; restored grants do not revive the old generation.
oracles.negative: No REOPEN, current-source read, rebind or recovery renews a deadline, reoffers, reissues authority, or writes the manual receipt.

oracles.title: P1/P2-only consumer scope remains independent
oracles.stimulus: Read or verify an otherwise current P1-only/P2-only plan or goal while an unrelated ordinary offer expires during a real final lock wait.
oracles.expect: Unrelated ordinary deadline does not turn these original consumers into 403 or falsely block their current local output. P3/P4/P5 consumers retain their actual-source protections.
oracles.negative: Merely observing an ordinary marker must not attach the deadline to every Case read.

oracles.title: Resource time checked after final ledger wait
oracles.stimulus: Hold the lifecycle ledger lock, let a resource/hold or reservation window expire while a P5 read or VERIFY is waiting, then release the owned lock.
oracles.expect: The actual response or write evaluates database time after that wait. It cannot report CURRENT/LOCAL_OUTPUT_VERIFIED or commit a stale P5 VERIFY. Any failure preserves original business revisions and events.
oracles.negative: A pre-ledger _timed result, first source capture, or ordinary-only _live callback is insufficient evidence of current resource time.

oracles.title: Ordinary deadline checked after final lifecycle wait
oracles.stimulus: Hold the final original Case/ledger/operation lock and cross first-offer deadline during REVALIDATE, CLOSE, P5 VERIFY or goal-result retrieval.
oracles.expect: A current P5 operation is denied/blocked after the last wait, without invalid commit or false-current output; actual response and unchanged relevant business rows must be captured.
oracles.negative: No claim of commit-time atomicity beyond the implemented last-admission check; observing a timeout or missing HTTP response alone is not a semantic result.

oracles.title: Current ledger requires original immutable proof
oracles.stimulus: Keep or forge a matching ledger state/snapshot SHA while the corresponding original REVALIDATE or latest CLOSE event/request fingerprint, actor, scope, IDs, revision/cycle, snapshot or payload is absent or inconsistent.
oracles.expect: Current lifecycle/P5 cannot certify a valid current local record from ledger fields alone. The reused original proof rejects corruption and preserves historical source/event bytes.
oracles.negative: Do not implement a second event verifier from a copied algorithm or accept a self-consistent rehash as proof of the original request.

oracles.title: Owner history separates EXECUTE from READ/PREPARE
oracles.stimulus: After a valid close, remove only owner EXECUTE while retaining current required owner READ/PREPARE and all resource READ scopes.
oracles.expect: Owner historical read/recovery remains readable with write controls disabled; all lifecycle writes, new P5 VERIFY and original POST replay are denied. Restoring capability does not change original offer deadline or generations.
oracles.negative: Removing owner READ/PREPARE must deny. Historical-resource READ required by original recovery is not bypassed by the phrase historical access.

oracles.title: Executor and reviewer limits remain original
oracles.stimulus: Use the accepted executor and the currently assigned reviewer against lifecycle read/command/recovery, whole-plan/goal-results and record pack.
oracles.expect: Executor gains no whole Case, P5, goal-results, pack or Run read; no role can owner-VERIFY or close for the owner. Reviewer sees only the original allowed responsible status, without newly expanded source snapshots, receipt/material bodies or private event payloads.
oracles.negative: CaseStep acceptance or a marker never confers whole-Run READ, owner role or cross-Case scope.

oracles.title: REOPEN after invalid old dependencies does not renew them
oracles.stimulus: After close, expire or revoke old ordinary executor dependencies, then explicitly REOPEN as a currently authorized owner.
oracles.expect: Original REOPEN may succeed despite old-source invalidity, increments cycle, sets REOPENED, clears current validation and retains all old events/evidence. No reservation is released, receipt rewritten, offer replaced, deadline extended or authority reissued. A subsequent REVALIDATE still needs original current prerequisites and therefore cannot reuse expired acceptance.
oracles.negative: Do not register an old P5 _live callback for REOPEN merely because an old ledger or marker exists.

oracles.title: Original-key cold recovery stays historical and read-only
oracles.stimulus: Cold restart after each of REVALIDATE, CLOSE and REOPEN; GET each original actor/key before and after a later cycle or dependency change.
oracles.expect: COMMITTED returns the exact original receipt/action/revision/cycle and the current projection separately. Old original_is_current_version becomes false after a later operation; NOT_OBSERVED remains unknown. Repeated GETs do not POST, revalidate, close, reopen, restore a cycle or mutate business tables.
oracles.negative: Current invalidity never erases a valid original COMMITTED event; corruption/scope mismatch is rejected rather than silently treated as NOT_OBSERVED.

oracles.title: Recovery compatibility is truthful about original proof
oracles.stimulus: Recover a historical valid REOPEN including the legacy permitted ignored optional expected_snapshot_sha256, plus original validation and close events.
oracles.expect: REVALIDATE/CLOSE reconstruct the exact saved original source SHA and request fingerprint. REOPEN preserves original structural proof and documented inability to reconstruct its optional ignored body field; it does not invent or retroactively tighten historical proof.
oracles.negative: A current forged REOPEN or inconsistent event coordinate is not accepted merely because a legacy optional body field was not reconstructible.

oracles.title: CAS, key conflicts, concurrency, rollback and history bounds
oracles.stimulus: Repeat the same key/body; use same key/different fingerprint; race close/reopen against stale expected revision/cycle; fail an event insert; reach original history/cycle limits.
oracles.expect: Original idempotency, bounded 64-revision history and reopen headroom remain. Stale/conflicting requests do not both commit; event failure rolls back ledger and Case state; no previous event or later cycle is overwritten.
oracles.negative: This small slice reuses existing concurrency/rollback algorithms and does not claim their whole historical matrix was rerun.

oracles.title: Original current results and TXT pack remain a limited record index
oracles.stimulus: After explicit current P5 VERIFY, read original goal-results and generate/download the original TXT via a cold configured_app and full original HTML flow; then invalidate sources/reopen.
oracles.expect: Allowed P5 output references actual lifecycle cycle/revision/revalidation evidence with original owner VERIFY and current dependencies. The pack follows existing re-read/hash/whitelist and clears changed/forbidden results. History and all required goals remain visible; no material/receipt body, credential or private full source snapshot is exported.
oracles.negative: LOCAL_OUTPUTS_VERIFIED is local SYNTHETIC evidence only. case_goal_completed=false, qualification NOT_EVALUATED, external NOT_SUBMITTED, offline NO_EVIDENCE. No formal AT35 or physical service completion claim.

oracles.title: Original UI intent and cold-unknown boundaries
oracles.stimulus: Use original controls for explicit REVALIDATE/CLOSE/P5 VERIFY/REOPEN and original opaque recovery handles; switch Case/identity while original GET or POST recovery is in flight.
oracles.expect: Original explicit commands and GET-only unknown recovery remain separate; current 403 clears private views while recovery handles survive. Late success/denial cannot replace a new Case/identity view; no automatic business resend, silent VERIFY, localStorage token/body or goal reduction occurs.
oracles.negative: HTML NodeVM and owned Linux HTTP are bounded engineering evidence; browser/Windows/formal AT35/real sources/init remain NOT_RUN.

bounded_future_probe_groups.design: Original HTTP full path and hostile roles/default lane; use true owned original records and inspect exact outputs, not a synthetic alternate workflow wrapper.
One original-event corruption composite against a valid current ledger and original-key cold recovery; preserve original failed diagnostics and reject false current P5 proof.
Owner EXECUTE historical split, executor dependency invalidity, authorized explicit REOPEN, failed stale revalidation and original-key GET-only recovery; compare business snapshots.
Real owned PG lock wait crossing an original ordinary/resource deadline. Record exact waiter identity, database time and actual HTTP status/detail, not inference from a missing response.
Narrow original P1/P2-only current source scope and one suitable original CAS/key-conflict boundary; do not rerun historical full matrices.
Cold ordinary app/original full HTML close-reopen-P5/result/TXT read path and original unknown-recovery handle behavior, with minimal meaningful root-selector overlap.

pending_clarifications: P5 READY and LOCAL_RECORD_CLOSED original compatibility is retained; the target demonstration explicitly closes before VERIFY.
Historical expiry/dependency-revocation readability still requires current owner READ/PREPARE and original required resource READ.
Legacy REOPEN complete optional body fingerprint cannot be reconstructed; preserve original structural proof truthfully.
